speaker: william_shakespeare
text: That is not St Helen's. That is off toward the Hill, and it is under half a mile.

speaker: (a boy)
text: A thousand of them on Tower Hill. Warders with them. Shut your doors.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. Up. You will sleep in my chamber tonight, and you will not argue it from the street.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am not arguing. I am looking. I cannot see any thousand.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Nor can I. We are not going out to improve the number.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: The bar, Master Shakespeare. Take the other end. It is a door, not a pageant. We have barred it every night since you took the room.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Every night, Mistress. Tonight it is only heavier, and we will not say so.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: There. If anyone in the close asks, we were tired of the heat. I will have no light in the front. A lit pane draws a stone.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I had not asked him.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You did not need to. He is off the street. Take no candle after him past the turn.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: And me, Mistress? The chamber is yours. I kick.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then kick the truckle, and not the shutter. In.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: In, Alse. The close is a poor place to be brave from.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I was not going to be brave. I was going to look once.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: You have looked. Master Shakespeare, bar your own door when you are up. I am not your sentry, and I am carrying these keys.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will bar it. The candle in my room is the one I mean to keep.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Keep it off the front. Has anyone remembered that candle, or am I to come down again for a lodger's light?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: It is mine, Mistress. It is the only light in the house.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then keep your hand round it, and let the front windows stay black.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: They are black. You will not have to come down.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Then we are ordinary, which is what I prefer to be shouted. The loaf can wait till morning. So can your cleverness.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: If they come, I shall be under your quilt, Mistress, and useless.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Useless and indoors. That is the whole duty. Up.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am going. If the thousand comes to the door, I shall still be under the quilt.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Good night, Mistress. Ordinary it is.
